tasks.title: Rewrite a message
tasks.description: Turn a rough message into a clear, friendly draft.
tasks.instruction: Rewrite the following message clearly and politely. Keep its meaning. Return only the rewritten message.
tasks.example: I cannot attend our meeting tomorrow. Could we move it to Friday morning?

tasks.title: Summarize a note
tasks.description: Extract the main point from a short note.
tasks.instruction: Summarize the following note in one sentence. Use only facts in the note. Return only the summary.
tasks.example: The garden workshop takes place on Saturday at 10 am. Bring gloves and a small container. Seeds and tools will be provided. The event ends at noon.

tasks.title: Explore an idea
tasks.description: Get a short starting point to develop yourself.
tasks.instruction: Suggest three practical ideas for the following request. Use one short sentence for each.
tasks.example: Useful things to do with a Raspberry Pi at home.

tasks.title: Try your own request
tasks.description: An open experiment with the model you choose.
tasks.example: Explain how a seed grows into a plant in three sentences.

tasks.title: Control Home Assistant
tasks.description: Use the existing Home Assistant integration. Device permissions and execution stay in Home Assistant. Product validation is still in progress.
